subject: Mathematics
name: Basic 5 Mathematics
description: The Basic 5 Mathematics curriculum expands on previous knowledge, introducing numbers up to 1,000,000, Roman numerals up to 100, and deeper exploration of factors, multiples, and prime numbers. It covers advanced operations with fractions and decimals, introduces percentages and integers, and develops algebraic thinking through patterns and equations. Geometry topics include quadrilaterals, volume, and transformations, while data handling focuses on double bar graphs and probability.
